Ridge-stabilized whitening and recoloring of WGS fingerprints

Source: R/wgs_ld.R
susieout_transform_fingerprints.Rd

Computes R_analysis^(1/2) R_wgs_SS^(-1/2) cross_ld with eigenvalue regularization, including rank-deficient input matrices. Use it when LD among tested variants in the sequencing panel differs from the analysis LD, so that the fingerprints are expressed on the analysis LD scale.

Usage

susieout_transform_fingerprints(R_analysis, R_wgs_SS, cross_ld, ridge = 1e-06)

Arguments

R_analysis

LD matrix among tested variants used in the analysis.

R_wgs_SS

LD matrix among the same tested variants in the sequencing reference panel.

cross_ld

Reference-panel LD between tested variants (rows) and omitted variants (columns).

ridge

Positive eigenvalue floor used for regularization.

Value

A matrix of transported fingerprints with the same dimensions as cross_ld.
